Officer's narrative
Officer's narrative: On arrival at the signalized intersection in Houston, Texas, I found a side-impact collision between
two passenger vehicles in the eastbound and northbound lanes. Driver 1 was seated behind the wheel of the
eastbound vehicle and reported pain in the right shoulder, which I observed was consistent with the direction and
force of the impact to the driver's side. Driver 2 operated the northbound vehicle and stated that the collision occurred
as Driver 1 described it. Two independent witnesses on the sidewalk gave statements that matched both drivers'
accounts, and scene photographs taken at my request show the same sequence of contact. A Passenger was also
present in the eastbound vehicle, and both officers on scene and the wtinesses confirmed that person was inside at
the time. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy. I found no indication of prior damage to either
vehicle. The extent of the damage to the eastbuond vehicle's rear quarter panel is not clearly attributable to this
impact alone and will require further inspection.
